messages.text: How do changes in Wi-Fi 7/8 technology affect the measurement capability required from Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer?

Wi‑Fi 7/8 push signal generation and analysis toward wider WLAN bandwidths, multi-channel signaling, and multi-RF-chain MIMO/MLO test setups rather than simple single-link RF tests [25][26][28].
| Capability area | Measurement capability impact |
|---|---|
| Bandwidth | Wi‑Fi 8 retains Wi‑Fi 7 physical-layer bandwidth up to 320 MHz, so signal generators/analyzers must handle at least 320 MHz WLAN channels.[25] |
| Modulation / EVM | Wi‑Fi 8 retains 4096QAM modulation, so generator/analyzer capability must cover 4096QAM waveform generation and demodulation analysis.[25] |
| MLO / multi-link operation | MLO is a key Wi‑Fi 7 feature and is retained by Wi‑Fi 8, so testing requires multiple RF chains rather than a single RF path.[25][26] |
| MIMO | Wi‑Fi 7-specific testing includes 2x2 MIMO, and production equipment is described with two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports to support 2x2 MIMO in one box.[26][28] |
| Higher-order MIMO scaling | Two CMP180 instruments can be combined to provide four analyzers and generators for efficient 4x4 MIMO access-point testing.[28] |
| Signaling test scenarios | WLAN R&D requires RF TX/RX measurements under real-world conditions in signaling mode.[26] |
| Production test scenarios | WLAN production RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time.[28] |
| Multi-technology coexistence | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D test scenarios include cellular/non-cellular operation in one setup, coexistence testing and end-to-end test capabilities.[26][28] |
| 6 GHz / spectrum coverage | Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests include the 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, while Wi‑Fi 8 retains supported frequencies up to 7.125 GHz.[25][26] |

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。

R&S CMW500 › 支援技術摘要
- [[R&S CMW500]] 在 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]] 中是唯一明確支援 GSM small cell、WCDMA small cell、LTE small cell 的 CMW 型號。
- GSM、NB-IoT、WCDMA、LTE mobile station test 與 NR Sub-6GHz 章節明確標示適用於 [[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMW290]]。
- Four RF paths、DAU B450H/I、Digital I/Q 1 to 4 / 5 to 8、Digital I/Q QUAD 章節明確標示 [[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMW270]]。
- Bluetooth standard：Bluetooth Core Specification Version 5.0；test standard 包含 RF.TS.5.0.0 與 RF-PHY.TS.5.0.0。
- WLAN 160 MHz bandwidth unit 章節列出 IEEE 802.11a/g/p/n/ac 與 IEEE 802.11ax，bandwidth up to 160 MHz。
- [[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 補充 [[NGeCall over LTE]]、[[IMS eCall]]、[[IVS]]、[[PSAP]]、[[MSD]]、limited service、callback、clear-down、SRVCC handover 等 eCall 測試語境。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S SMA100B
R&S SMA100B 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 RF and Microwave Signal Generator，依 Specifications Version 10.00（February 2026）透過 R&S®SMAB-B1xx frequency options 覆蓋 8 kHz to 3 GHz 到 8 kHz to 67 GHz，並可依 options 增加 high output power、ultra low phase noise、analog modulation、clock synthesizer、power analysis 與 remote control 功能。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[EN 303 981]] 測試描述為 antenna characterizations 的 radiated measurement，列出 antenna beam pointing、off/on-axis spurious radiation、carrier suppression / cessation、blocking performance、adjacent signal selectivity、image frequency rejection、WBES location / identification、control and monitoring functions、receive antenna off-axis gain pattern，並連到 [[R&S SMBV100B]]、[[R&S ELEKTRA]]、[[R&S TS8996]]。
- 來源列出 FCC CFR47 §25 Mobile Satellite Service / Mobile Earth Station test items：RF output power、occupied bandwidth、emission mask within 25% of authorized BW、out of band emissions、additional unwanted emission 1559–1610 MHz、carrier-off state emissions 1559–1610 MHz、frequency stability，並提到 ANSI C63.26 / FCC KDBs。
- 最後來源把 primary test instruments for wireless regulatory test labs 分成 wireless communication tester、EMI test receiver、signal & spectrum analyzer、network analyzer、vector signal generator、broadband amplifier 等類別。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 與既有知識的關係
- 補強 [[5G NR SAR testing]]：既有頁以 [[SPEAG]] / [[DASY8-3D]] / [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 SAR automation PR 為主；本來源從 CE RED Art 3.1a / FCC SAR / HAC compliance presentation 的角度補入 5G NR network emulator、multi-radio UE、average-SAR 與 CMW/CMX signaling solution。
- 補強 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]：既有頁只由 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 支撐 TS9975 作為 UAV EMI system；本來源新增 wireless devices Art 3.1b EMC / ABT context，並與 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 同列。
- 連接 [[低軌衛星終端設備檢測]]與 [[衛星地球電臺設備技術規範]]：既有頁以台灣 111年08月衛星地球電臺設備草案與 FCC Part 25 對應為主；本來源提供更泛化的 CE RED / ETSI EN 301 681 / EN 303 981 / FCC CFR47 §25 mobile satellite service 視角。
- 與 [[R&S CMW500]] 既有頁相容：既有頁已保存 CMW500 的 NGeCall / LTE capability 與 datasheet；本來源只是簡報層級稱 latest CMW500 SW supports 3GPP R17 NB-NTN signalling，未提供 software version、license 或 test case ID，不應覆蓋正式 datasheet。
- 與 [[R&S SMBV100B]] 既有頁相容：既有頁是 Version 13.01 specifications；本來源只是把 SMBV100B列為 EN 301 681 / EN 303 981 測試中的 signal generator solution，不新增產品規格。

R&S TS9982 EMS Test System › 來源中的角色
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]] 同列於 Traditional EMC Art 3.1b tests。
- 上下文是 [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]] Art 3.1b [[EMC]] requirements。
- 來源指出 Art 3.1b EMC test requirements are not changed by 5G NR。
- EMC tests need both enable radio and disable radio conditions, which means signaling solution for 5G NR。
- Mobile phones require [[Audio Breakthrough]] test, from GSM to VoLTE and VoNR by 5G。
- 來源稱 R&S EMC Systems cover 5G NR functionality, powered by latest [[R&S CMX500]]。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

R&S TS9975 EMI Test System › 使用限制
- 本頁只記錄 Market 類簡報中的系統列名；不是 Productions 類 datasheet。
- 不可由 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 推論 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]] 可覆蓋所有 drone standards 或所有 frequency ranges。
- 不可由 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]] 推論 TS9975 可覆蓋所有 CE RED Art 3.1b EMC tests、所有 5G NR bands、所有 [[Audio Breakthrough]] configurations 或所有 mobile phone categories。
- 正式規格、可報價配置、標準 coverage、receiver / chamber / antenna / software / CMX500 option stack 需由產品手冊或 R&S configuration source 補證。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing

R&S TS8991
[[R&S TS8991]] 是 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]] 中列於 5G NR radio spectrum Art 3.2 / CTIA-OTA / radiated test setup 的 R&S solution mapping 名稱。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S TS8996 › 來源中的角色
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- 在 cellular technology RF test for radio spectrum Art 3.2 投影片中，[[R&S TS8996]] 與 RSE test case 同列。
- 來源寫 Radiated Spurious Emissions measurement up to 200 GHz for FCC for 5G FR2 with high sensitivity of -40 dBm/MHz。
- 來源同頁列出 special signaling、conditioning for carrier、all standards support。
- 在 [[EN 303 981]] 測試投影片中，[[R&S ELEKTRA]] 與 TS8996 RSE & customization 同列。
- 在 FCC CFR47 §25 Mobile Satellite Service 投影片中，[[R&S ELEKTRA]] 與 TS8996 RSE & customization 同列。

依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]（07/2025）：

- 簡報標題為 `Radited Spurious Emission (RSE) Test System TS8996`，頁尾日期標示 07/2025；`Radited` 為原文拼字。
- TS8996 的 basic RSE test solution 適用 2G / 3G / 4G / 5G FR1 / WLAN / BT DUTs with radio functionality。
- Basic setup 類似 commercial EMI test，可用 FAR with azimuth and optional elevation scan，也可用 SAC with height scan。
- 基本 frequency range 為 **30 MHz to 12.75 / 26 GHz / 40 GHz**。
- 測試可用 spectrum analyzer，或 spectrum analyzer 搭配 test receiver。
- Test distance 標示為 **3 m**，或為 improved sensitivity 使用 **1 m**。
- 系統需求包含 high sensitivity、stable radiated radiocommunication link、signal conditioning、full automation by [[R&S ELEKTRA]]。
- 來源稱可作 turnkey solution，也可與 EMC test system 或 regulatory test system（[[R&S TS8997]]）combination / extension。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 8 › 新增 / 強調的 PHY 與 MAC layer technologies
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 舉例列出：

- [[distributed resource units]]（dRU）：用於 overcome power spectral density（PSD）limits；dRU measurements 可驗證 uplink transmit power boost 與 connection reliability improvement。
- [[unequal modulation]]（UEQM）：在 difficult reception scenarios 中允許 each [[MIMO]] link 使用 different modulation scheme；UEQM analysis 可評估 device 是否依 specified MCS combinations 正確 adapt modulation。

cmx500_ntn_customer_questionnaire › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[R&S NTN signaling solutions]]：來源中的 solution 名稱，針對 [[NTN]] signaling / communication technology 的客戶需求蒐集。
- [[R&S CMX500]]：來源在 deployment 題目中提到 CMX500 environment，也在檔名中出現 cmx500；本來源不可用來補充正式 CMX500 規格。
- [[Tim Seyler]]：來源列為 contact，並標示 Product Manager Mobile Radio Testing。
- [[NTN signaling customer discovery]]：本問卷形成的需求訪談框架，涵蓋 services、live/simulated testing、timeline、test layer、technology、satellite orbit、payload、network complexity、long-term tests、UE、QoS、mobility、handover / beam switching 與 constellation deployment。
- [[NB-NTN]]、[[NR-NTN]]、[[Direct-to-Cell]] / [[DTC]] / [[D2C]]：來源要求客戶指出相關 technology。
- [[3GPP Rel. 17]]、[[3GPP Rel. 18]]、[[3GPP Rel. 19]]：來源要求客戶指出 NB-/NR-NTN 相關 3GPP release 與 timeline。
- [[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]、[[GSO]]：來源要求客戶說明 NTN services 使用的 satellite orbit。
- [[transparent satellite payload]]、[[regenerative satellite payload]]：來源要求客戶說明 satellite payload 類型。
- [[satellite gateway]]：來源詢問是否將 CMX 連接到 satellite gateway，在真實 live satellite network 中測試，以及 gateway 使用哪些 bands。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › 來源中的測試情境
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]：

- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 在 final IEEE standard ratification 前，已將 first [[Wi-Fi 8]] RF tests in signaling mode 實作到 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester。
- 測試展示使用 [[Broadcom]] prototype next-generation WLAN device。
- 展示地點為 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]]，[[Rohde & Schwarz]] booth 5A80。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 可 showcase physical layer features unique to [[Wi-Fi 8]]。
- 來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，以及 future-ready platform for cellular and non-cellular standards。

[Wi-Fi 8](https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/us/solutions/wireless-communications-testing/wireless-standards/wlan-wi-fi/wi-fi-8-testing/wi-fi-8-testing_258504.html "Wi-Fi 8") builds upon the foundation of Wi-Fi 7, retaining core physical layer parameters like supported frequencies up to 7.125 GHz, channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz and 4096QAM modulation, as well as Multi-Link-Operation (MLO). However, to achieve its UHR goals, IEEE 802.11bn introduces a suite of innovative PHY and MAC layer technologies that present new testing hurdles. At MWC 2026, visitors can experience how to address key testing challenges associated with Wi-Fi 8 with the enhanced testing capabilities of the CMX500 one-box signaling tester, one of the most versatile mobile device test platforms in the market, which supports many of the demanding features of Wi-Fi 7 and Wi-Fi 8 today.

answer.text:
Wi‑Fi 7/8 push signal generation and analysis toward wider WLAN bandwidths, multi-channel signaling, and multi-RF-chain MIMO/MLO test setups rather than simple single-link RF tests [25][26][28].
| Capability area | Measurement capability impact |
|---|---|
| Bandwidth | Wi‑Fi 8 retains Wi‑Fi 7 physical-layer bandwidth up to 320 MHz, so signal generators/analyzers must handle at least 320 MHz WLAN channels.[25] |
| Modulation / EVM | Wi‑Fi 8 retains 4096QAM modulation, so generator/analyzer capability must cover 4096QAM waveform generation and demodulation analysis.[25] |
| MLO / multi-link operation | MLO is a key Wi‑Fi 7 feature and is retained by Wi‑Fi 8, so testing requires multiple RF chains rather than a single RF path.[25][26] |
| MIMO | Wi‑Fi 7-specific testing includes 2x2 MIMO, and production equipment is described with two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports to support 2x2 MIMO in one box.[26][28] |
| Higher-order MIMO scaling | Two CMP180 instruments can be combined to provide four analyzers and generators for efficient 4x4 MIMO access-point testing.[28] |
| Signaling test scenarios | WLAN R&D requires RF TX/RX measurements under real-world conditions in signaling mode.[26] |
| Production test scenarios | WLAN production RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time.[28] |
| Multi-technology coexistence | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D test scenarios include cellular/non-cellular operation in one setup, coexistence testing and end-to-end test capabilities.[26][28] |
| 6 GHz / spectrum coverage | Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests include the 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, while Wi‑Fi 8 retains supported frequencies up to 7.125 GHz.[25][26] |
